insurer: The New India Assurance Co. Ltd.
sum_insured_options: ₹10L – ₹20L (mentioned in cataract sub-limit table; full range not specified)

room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction on associate medical expenses if higher room chosen; not applied on pharmacy, implants, diagnostics

icu.note: Includes ICU bed, monitoring devices, critical care nursing and intensivist charges

copayment.note: Co-payment is mandatory and chosen at inception: either 70% insurer/30% insured or 50%/50%

sub_limits.display: Cataract, ARMD, mental illness, genetic, puberty/menopause, life support capped
sub_limits.note: Cataract: ₹1L (10L SI) / ₹1.5L (20L SI); ARMD: 10% SI max ₹75k; Mental illness: 25% SI; Genetic: 25% SI; Puberty/menopause: 25% SI; Life support: 10% SI max 15 days; Modern treatments: 25% SI each

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; not applicable after 12 months continuous coverage

ped_waiting.note: Reducible via portability credit from prior continuous coverage

specific_disease_waiting.note: Hernia, cataract, hydrocele, stones, joint replacement, mental illness, ARMD, genetic disorders etc.; Diabetes & hypertension: 90 days

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate if claim made; option to convert to premium discount instead

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in policy

day_care.note: Annexure I lists ~226 specific day care procedures

ayush.note: Inpatient hospitalisation under Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy covered up to full SI per policy year

organ_donor.note: Donor hospitalisation expenses covered (excluding cost of organ) within recipient's SI

ambulance.note: For emergency transfer to hospital or inter-hospital transfer

modern_treatments.note: 12 procedures listed including robotic surgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, stereotactic radiosurgery, stem cell therapy etc.

consumables.note: Gloves, masks, consumables listed under non-payable items in Annexure II List I

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment only within India (clause 5.18); treatment outside India excluded (4.4.27)

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud

grace_period.note: Coverage not available during grace period

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary treatment, treatment outside India, maternity, acupressure/acupuncture/magnetic therapy, external prosthetics/hearing aids, CPAP/BIPAP home equipment, vaccination
optional_riders: Co-payment ratio choice (30% or 50%) at inception; premium discount in lieu of cumulative bonus at renewal
